newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent gasoline prices firm in Chicago.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent gasoline prices firm in Chicago.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline prices moved higher in Chicago Thursday on firming differentials and steady futures prices, traders said.
Activity picked up in the cash markets as trade resumed following the New Year's holiday but several players remained out of the market, muting discussion in January deliveries, traders said.
"I think a lot of people are still out. Things probably won't be back to normal until next week," one Midwest trader said.
Unleaded firmed to bids 2.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded for January deliveries in Chicago and was heard done 2.30 cents under the print in Group Three, traders said.
High sulphur diesel for January deliveries was talked 6.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil in Chicago and 7.50 cents under the print in Group Three.
Low sulphur diesel was talked 5.0/4.75 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and Group Three, traders said.
